expectation: Membrane/fibrous stain of lymphatic endothelium (thin vessels in mucosa, submucosa and between muscle layers), plus stromal fibroblasts and FRC/FDC networks in lymphoid aggregates. A minor population sitting in lines and networks, with no epithelial signal.
notes: Both serial sections show the same sharp PDPN lines and networks between and across the muscle layers, with fine lymphatic-like dots in the mucosa. D shows a cell with branching membrane staining. The CD21 partner is diffuse haze, so the co-staining panel (E) can't confirm the result.
observed: A: sharp yellow lines along the muscle-layer boundary and radial septa, dots in the mucosa; the pattern repeats in both sections over dim haze. B/C: mostly haze, a few bright foci. D: branching membranous cell. E1: thin fibrous network; E2 CD21 is haze.
why: A distinct linear and network structure (lymphatics and stroma) is reproduced in both sections and stands out from the haze, as expected for PDPN.
